    public static int Run(int input)
    {
        var pair = input % (Values.Length * Values.Length);
        var left = Values[pair / Values.Length];
        var right = Values[pair % Values.Length];
        var result = (input / (Values.Length * Values.Length)) switch
        {
            0 => unchecked(left + right),
            1 => unchecked(left - right),
            2 => unchecked(left * right),
            3 => left / right,
            4 => left % right,
            5 => checked(left + right),
            6 => checked(left - right),
            _ => checked(left * right),
        };
        return result == Expected[input] ? 42 : -1;
    }
}
